name: BSP_UnitController_ApplyShipForces
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(controller, float dt) RET 4, body 00937440-0093762D. One of the four force-model overrides and the only place a command becomes a real force: it adds a rudder torque and then tail-calls 009329C0. Skipped when unit+5Dh is set (00937449). ratio = |dot(velocity, axis)|/GetReferenceSpeed, heel = |unit+D0h|, gain = (1-heel)*ratio*unit+984h*settings[588h], torque = mass*mass*gain*(unit+ECh,+F0h,+F4h)/10000.0 (00CE4BD8, a double), 00C35330 at 00937613. Which basis vector pose row 2 is has not been settled. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md

name: BSP_ShipSystems_RollComponentFailure
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol, and provisional. __thiscall(this, param, float delta), RET 8 at 0093c118. Gated on game+1FE4h in {0,1} and param+34h != -1; resolves a component through 008782a0(param+30h, param+34h) and forms p = (c+28h * delta) / c+2Ch, or the globals at [00424c40()+3DCh]/[+3E0h] when either float is negative, then draws 00bd2f10(0, 1.0f) and fires on draw <= p. On a fire it builds a record, calls the failure warning 00982c50 and 00913d80, and runs the owner's virtual +21Ch. This is component damage, not mission failure. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md.
